title: Email: Changes to Office Paperwork
topic: 電子郵件・辦公室文書
paragraphs:
To: All staff
From: Dana Lee, Office Manager
Subject: Changes to office paperwork

Starting on March 1, we will [[streamline|TO-0020]] our office [[paperwork|TO-0006]]. At the moment, too many forms are printed, signed, and kept in the [[storeroom|TO-0023]]. Most [[departmental|TO-0024]] forms will now be sent [[electronically|TO-0026]]. You will access the new system with your own [[login|TO-0013]], so please do not share it. Any [[unauthorized|TO-0030]] use will be reported to your manager.

Our [[outdated|TO-0010]] [[copier|TO-0004]] on the second floor will also be replaced next month. Until then, if it runs out of [[toner|TO-0021]], please ask Ms. Park, our [[receptionist|TO-0002]], for a new [[cartridge|TO-0005]]. Please do not try to change it yourself, because the machine is easy to damage.

Training sessions will be held on February 24 and 25 at 3 p.m. in Meeting Room B. Each session takes about one hour. Please sign up with Ms. Park by February 20. If you cannot attend either day, tell me, and I will find another time for you.

Thank you,
Dana Lee
zh:
收件者：全體員工
寄件者：辦公室經理 Dana Lee
主旨：辦公室文書作業的變動
從 3 月 1 日起，我們將精簡辦公室的文書作業。目前有太多表單是列印、簽名後再放進儲藏室保管。大部分部門表單今後將以電子方式傳送。你們將用自己的登入帳號進入新系統，所以請不要與他人共用。任何未經授權的使用都會通報給你的主管。
二樓那台老舊的影印機下個月也會被汰換。在那之前，如果影印機的碳粉用完了，請向我們的接待人員 Park 女士領取新的碳粉匣。請不要自己嘗試更換，因為這台機器很容易損壞。
教育訓練將在 2 月 24 日和 25 日下午 3 點於 B 會議室舉行，每場約一小時。請在 2 月 20 日前向 Park 女士報名。如果這兩天你都無法參加，請告訴我，我會替你另外安排時間。

謝謝大家，
Dana Lee

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To explain new ways of handling office forms and equipment
To ask staff to buy new office supplies
To announce that the office will move
To invite staff to a company party
questions.explain: 信中說明將精簡文書作業、改用電子表單與新登入系統，並提到更換影印機與訓練，故選 (A)。(C) 信中並未提到辦公室要搬遷。
questions.evidence: Starting on March 1, we will streamline our office paperwork.

questions.stem: Who should employees ask for a new toner cartridge?
questions.explain: 第二段指出碳粉用完時要向接待人員 Ms. Park 領取，故選 (B)。(A) Dana Lee 是寫信的人，信中並未要求員工向她領取。
questions.evidence: Until then, if it runs out of toner, please ask Ms. Park, our receptionist, for a new cartridge.

questions.stem: What are employees asked to do by February 20?
options: Sign up for a training session
questions.explain: 第三段要求員工在 2 月 20 日前向 Ms. Park 報名訓練，故選 (C)。(D) 信中沒有要求把表單送去儲藏室，反而是要減少紙本保管。
questions.evidence: Please sign up with Ms. Park by February 20.

questions.stem: What is suggested about the office's old system?
options: It is faster than the new one.
It is used only by managers.
questions.explain: 信中說目前許多表單仍用列印、簽名並存放於儲藏室，可見舊系統大量使用紙本，故選 (D)。(A) 信中並沒有說舊系統比較快；(C) 信中正是因為紙本作業太多才要改變，並未提到舊系統最近更新過。

vocab.explain: 要讓新人更快上工，表示把流程簡化、使更有效率，故選 streamline。postpone（延後）、overlook（忽略）、withdraw（撤回）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: The copy machine is out of ______, so all the pages come out blank.
vocab.explain: 影印出來是空白，表示碳粉用完，故選 toner。receptionist（接待人員）、storeroom（儲藏室）、login（登入帳號）都無法說明影印出空白頁的原因。

title: Memo: Computer Check on Friday
paragraphs:
MEMO
To: Finance Department
From: Kevin Brooks, IT Supervisor
Date: October 8
Re: Computer check

On Friday, October 12, the IT team will run a [[diagnostic|TO-0025]] check on every computer in the building. The work will start at 6 p.m. and should be finished by 9 p.m. During this time, the network will be off, and the office [[modem|TO-0028]] will be restarted.

Before you leave on Friday, please save your work and log out, but do not [[unplug|TO-0031]] your desktop computer. Please also [[delete|TO-0008]] any files you no longer need, because a full hard drive slows down the check.

After the check, we plan to [[automate|TO-0009]] the monthly [[spreadsheet|TO-0019]] reports so that nobody has to enter numbers by hand. Computers will also be checked [[periodically|TO-0016]], about once every three months. If you [[misplace|TO-0012]] a cable or find that something is missing after the work, please tell the help desk. Do not [[rearrange|TO-0011]] the cables behind your desk, even if they look messy.
zh:
備忘錄
收件者：財務部
寄件者：資訊部主管 Kevin Brooks
日期：10 月 8 日
事由：電腦檢查
10 月 12 日星期五，資訊團隊將對大樓內的每一台電腦進行診斷檢查。工作將從下午 6 點開始，預計晚上 9 點前完成。在這段時間，網路會中斷，辦公室的數據機也會重新啟動。
星期五下班前，請先儲存你的檔案並登出，但不要拔掉桌上型電腦的插頭。也請刪除不再需要的檔案，因為硬碟太滿會拖慢檢查速度。
檢查完成後，我們打算把每月的試算表報告自動化，這樣就不必再手動輸入數字。電腦之後也會定期檢查，大約每三個月一次。如果你在作業後弄丟了線材，或發現有東西不見了，請告訴服務台。即使桌子後面的線看起來很亂，也請不要自行重新整理。

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To ask staff to buy new computers
To tell staff how to get ready for a computer check
To report that the network is broken
To explain a change in working hours
questions.explain: 備忘錄說明週五將檢查電腦，並要求員工先存檔登出、不要拔插頭，並刪除不需要的檔案，故選 (B)。(A) 文中沒有提到要買新電腦。
questions.evidence: Before you leave on Friday, please save your work and log out, but do not unplug your desktop computer.

questions.stem: When is the check expected to end?
questions.explain: 第一段說工作從下午 6 點開始、晚上 9 點前完成，日期是 10 月 12 日，故選 (B)。(D) 6 點是開始時間，不是結束時間。

questions.stem: Why should staff delete old files?
options: A full hard drive makes the check slower.
The files may be stolen during the check.
The IT team needs more office space.
The new reports cannot be saved.
questions.explain: 第二段明說硬碟太滿會拖慢檢查，所以要刪檔案，故選 (A)。(B) 文中沒有提到檔案被偷。
questions.evidence: Please also delete any files you no longer need, because a full hard drive slows down the check.

questions.stem: What is most likely true about the monthly reports now?
options: They are already done by a computer.
They are checked once a year.
They are put together mostly by hand.
questions.explain: IT 打算讓報告自動化，好讓人不用再手動輸入數字，可見目前多半靠人工，故選 (D)。(A) 若已經自動化就不需要說「計畫」了。

vocab.stem: Our computers are checked ______, usually once every three months.
vocab.explain: once every three months 表示固定一段時間重複一次，故選 periodically（定期地）。carelessly（粗心地）、silently（安靜地）、unfortunately（不幸地）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: Please ______ the old e-mails you do not need so that your mailbox has more space.
vocab.explain: 信箱要有更多空間，應該刪除不需要的郵件，故選 delete。rearrange（重新佈置）、unplug（拔插頭）、proofread（校對）都無法讓信箱空出空間。

title: Emails: Ordering Office Supplies
topic: 電子郵件・訂購辦公用品（雙篇）
paragraphs:
--- E-mail 1 ---
To: Hal Nunez, Operations Director
From: Rita Gomez, Office Assistant
Date: June 3
Subject: Request for approval

Dear Mr. Nunez,
Our staff [[photocopy|TO-0003]] nearly 2,000 pages a month, and our supply of [[toner|TO-0021]] is almost gone. I need your [[authorization|TO-0017]] to order the items below.
6 boxes of toner at $45 each = $270
2 packs of [[letterhead|TO-0027]] paper at $30 each = $60
Total: $330

I would also like to stop sending customer letters by [[postal|TO-0018]] mail and send them [[electronically|TO-0026]] instead. It is cheaper and faster.
Rita

--- E-mail 2 ---
To: Rita Gomez, Office Assistant
From: Hal Nunez, Operations Director
Date: June 4
Subject: RE: Request for approval

Dear Rita,
Thank you for the list. I approve the paper, but please order only 4 boxes of toner, not 6, because the old machine will be replaced in July. The delivery date was [[unspecified|TO-0015]] on the price list, so please ask the seller for it. Before anything is printed on the new letterhead, please ask Ms. Chen to [[proofread|TO-0014]] it. Your idea about customer letters is a good one. Let's talk about it on Friday.
Hal

日期：6 月 3 日

--- 電子郵件 2 ---
收件者：辦公室助理 Rita Gomez
寄件者：營運總監 Hal Nunez
日期：6 月 4 日
主旨：回覆：請求核准

Rita 妳好：
謝謝妳提供清單。我核准信紙的部分，但請只訂 4 盒碳粉，不要訂 6 盒，因為舊機器 7 月就會被換掉。價目表上沒有註明送貨日期，所以請向賣家詢問。在新的公司抬頭信紙印上任何東西之前，請 Chen 女士先校對。妳關於客戶信函的想法很好，我們星期五再談。

questions.stem: Why did Ms. Gomez write to Mr. Nunez?
options: To report that a machine is broken
To ask for a new job
To get his approval for an order
To complain about a late delivery

questions.evidence: I need your authorization to order the items below.

questions.stem: Why does Mr. Nunez want fewer boxes of toner?
options: The company will get a new copy machine in July.
The company will print fewer letters.
questions.explain: 第二封信說舊機器 7 月就會被更換，所以只訂 4 盒，故選 (A)。(B) 信中並未嫌價格太貴，他只是減少數量。

questions.stem: How much will the company most likely spend on the order?
questions.explain: 需合併兩封信：Hal 核准信紙 60 美元，碳粉改訂 4 盒，4 × 45 = 180 美元，合計 240 美元，故選 (B)。(A) 330 美元是 Rita 原本申請的總額。

questions.stem: What does Ms. Gomez suggest about sending customer letters?
options: It should be done on Fridays.
It would be cheaper to send them by e-mail.

vocab.explain: 寄給客戶前要仔細檢查文字錯誤，故選 proofread（校對）。automate（自動化）、unplug（拔插頭）、reschedule（改期）都不合句意。

title: Email: Planning Meeting Moved
paragraphs:
To: All project team members
From: Priya Shah, Project Coordinator
Subject: Change to Tuesday's meeting

I am writing to let you know that we must [[reschedule|TO-0032]] the [[upcoming|TO-0033]] planning meeting. Mr. Evans, our main [[presenter|TO-0036]], has to fly to Chicago on Tuesday, so he will not be in the office. Please check your calendar and tell me your [[availability|TO-0035]] for Wednesday or Thursday of next week.

The meeting will now be held in the [[boardroom|TO-0040]] on the fifth floor. We will begin with a short [[overview|TO-0039]] of the schedule. After that, we will [[brainstorm|TO-0045]] ideas for the customer event in May. We hope to [[finalize|TO-0037]] the budget by the end of the meeting, so please read the attached [[timeline|TO-0047]] first. Each [[attendee|TO-0034]] should bring at least two ideas.
Please reply by Friday at noon. I will send the new date as soon as everyone has answered. I am sorry for the trouble.
Priya Shah
zh:
收件者：全體專案團隊成員
寄件者：專案協調員 Priya Shah
主旨：週二會議異動
我寫這封信是要通知大家，我們必須把即將舉行的企劃會議改期。我們的主要簡報者 Evans 先生星期二必須飛往芝加哥，所以他不會在辦公室。請查看你的行事曆，告訴我你下週三或週四有沒有空。
會議現在將改在五樓的會議室舉行。我們會先簡短說明整體時程，接著腦力激盪五月客戶活動的點子。我們希望在會議結束前把預算定案，所以請先閱讀附上的時程表。每位與會者應至少帶兩個點子。
請在週五中午前回覆。等大家都回覆後，我會立刻通知新的日期。造成不便，敬請見諒。
Priya Shah

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To say that a meeting will be held at a different time
To ask for a larger budget
To introduce a new team member
questions.explain: 信中說明會議必須改期，並請大家回報可行的時間，故選 (A)。(B) 信中雖提到預算，但只是會議要討論的內容之一。
questions.evidence: I am writing to let you know that we must reschedule the upcoming planning meeting.

questions.stem: Why must the meeting be changed?
options: Ms. Shah is going on a trip.
Mr. Evans will be away on Tuesday.
The boardroom is not free on Tuesday.
questions.explain: 第一段說主要簡報者 Mr. Evans 週二要去芝加哥，所以改期，故選 (B)。(C) 信中沒有說會議室被占用，只說會議室換成五樓。
questions.evidence: Mr. Evans, our main presenter, has to fly to Chicago on Tuesday, so he will not be in the office.

questions.stem: What should attendees do before the meeting?
options: Send the budget to Mr. Evans
Write a report on the customer event
Read the timeline and prepare ideas
questions.explain: 第二段要求大家先閱讀附上的時程表，並每人至少帶兩個點子，故選 (D)。(B) 預算是會中要定案的，沒有要求事先寄給 Evans。
questions.evidence: Each attendee should bring at least two ideas.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the new meeting date?
options: It has not been decided yet.
It will be the same as before.
questions.explain: 信中請大家回報週三或週四的空檔，等所有人回覆後才會寄出新日期，可見尚未決定，故選 (B)。(A) 週五是回覆的期限，不是開會日。
questions.evidence: I will send the new date as soon as everyone has answered.

vocab.stem: Please check your ______ and tell me when you are free next week.
vocab.explain: 要告訴對方什麼時候有空，是在回報可行的時間，故選 availability（空檔）。effectiveness（效果）、overview（概要）、paraphrase（改述）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: I have a doctor's appointment on Monday, so we need to ______ our meeting to Tuesday.
vocab.explain: 因為週一有約，要把會議挪到週二，故選 reschedule（改期）。delete（刪除）、unplug（拔插頭）、misplace（弄丟）都不能搭配 to Tuesday。

title: Article: Making Meetings Work
paragraphs: WORKPLACE TIPS: Making Meetings Work Better
Many workers say that meetings take too much time. Here are three simple ways to improve the [[effectiveness|TO-0042]] of yours.

First, choose the right way to meet. A [[videoconference|TO-0048]] saves travel time when team members work in different cities, while an [[informal|TO-0041]] chat at someone's desk is enough for a small question. Save the [[boardroom|TO-0040]] for important talks. Give each [[presenter|TO-0036]] ten minutes, and keep to the [[timeline|TO-0047]] on the agenda.

Second, listen carefully. When someone gives a long answer, try to [[paraphrase|TO-0043]] it in a few words, such as "So you are saying that the delivery will be late." This shows that you understand. Also, ask questions that need a clear answer. An [[affirmative|TO-0044]] answer means the group can move on.
Third, end with action. Write down who will do what and by when. If a plan does not work after a month, do not be afraid to [[reconsider|TO-0046]] it.
zh: 職場小秘訣：讓會議更有效率
許多上班族說開會太耗時間。以下三個簡單的方法，可以提升你的會議成效。
第一，選擇適合的開會方式。當團隊成員分處不同城市時，視訊會議可以節省交通時間；而在某人座位旁非正式聊一聊，就足以處理小問題。把會議室留給重要的討論。給每位簡報者十分鐘，並遵守議程上的時程。
第二，專心傾聽。當有人給了很長的回答時，試著用幾句話改述，例如「所以你的意思是貨會晚到。」這能表示你聽懂了。另外，要問能得到明確答案的問題。肯定的回答代表大家可以進入下一項。
第三，以行動作結。寫下誰要做什麼、何時完成。如果一個計畫一個月後仍不見效，不要害怕重新考慮。

questions.stem: What is the article mainly about?
options: How to travel to a meeting
Simple ways to hold better meetings
Which meeting room is the best
questions.explain: 全文提供三個讓會議更有效率的方法，故選 (B)。(D) 文中只說重要的討論用會議室，並未比較哪間最好。
questions.evidence: Here are three simple ways to improve the effectiveness of yours.

questions.stem: According to the article, when is a videoconference useful?
options: When team members are in different cities
When the topic is very small
When a plan must be changed
questions.explain: 第二段說團隊成員分處不同城市時，視訊會議可省下交通時間，故選 (A)。(B) 小問題適合的是在座位旁的非正式聊天。
questions.evidence: A videoconference saves travel time when team members work in different cities, while an informal chat at someone's desk is enough for a small question.

questions.stem: The word "paraphrase" in the article is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: 文中 paraphrase 後面舉例用另一種話重述對方的意思，與 restate（重述）最接近，故選 (C)。(B) record 是「記錄」，文中沒有要求錄下發言。
questions.evidence: When someone gives a long answer, try to paraphrase it in a few words, such as "So you are saying that the delivery will be late."

questions.stem: What would the writer most likely suggest if a plan is not working well?
options: Ask the presenter to talk more
questions.explain: 作者說計畫一個月後不見效時，不要怕重新考慮，故選 (D)。(A) 文中並未建議立刻停止。
questions.evidence: If a plan does not work after a month, do not be afraid to reconsider it.

vocab.stem: Before we sign the contract, we should ______ the price once more.
vocab.explain: 簽約前要再想一次價格，故選 reconsider（重新考慮）。unplug（拔插頭）、automate（自動化）、reschedule（改期）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: The new training program has improved the ______ of our sales team.
vocab.explain: 訓練讓業務團隊的「成效」提升，故選 effectiveness。boardroom（會議室）、attendee（與會者）、luncheon（午餐會）都無法被「提升」。

title: Notice and Email: Staff Luncheon
topic: 公告與電子郵件・員工午餐會（雙篇）
paragraphs:
--- Notice ---
ANNUAL STAFF LUNCHEON
Date: Friday, December 14
Place: Harbor Room, Grand Hotel

All employees are invited to our [[upcoming|TO-0033]] [[luncheon|TO-0038]]. The event is [[informal|TO-0041]], so there is no need to dress up. Lunch will be served at 12:00. At 12:45, we will give out the yearly awards. At 1:15, our guest [[presenter|TO-0036]], Dr. Lin, will give a talk on teamwork.
Please check your [[availability|TO-0035]] and reply by December 7 so that we can [[finalize|TO-0037]] the number of meals. Staff in our Taipei office can join by [[videoconference|TO-0048]].

--- E-mail ---
To: Events Office
From: Tom Reyes, Taipei Office
Date: December 5
Subject: Staff luncheon

Hello,
I would like to join the luncheon, but my client meeting does not end until 1:00 p.m. Can I join by video after that? I am free from then on, and I most want to hear Dr. Lin's talk. As an [[attendee|TO-0034]] from another office, I would also like to know whether the awards will be shown online.
zh:
--- 公告 ---
年度員工午餐會
日期：12 月 14 日星期五
地點：Grand 飯店 Harbor 廳
邀請全體員工參加即將舉行的午餐會。活動氣氛輕鬆，不需要盛裝出席。12:00 開始用餐，12:45 頒發年度獎項，1:15 由特邀講者 Lin 博士以團隊合作為題發表演說。
請確認你的時間並於 12 月 7 日前回覆，以便我們確定餐點數量。台北辦公室的同仁可以用視訊方式參加。

--- 電子郵件 ---
收件者：活動辦公室
寄件者：台北辦公室 Tom Reyes
日期：12 月 5 日
主旨：員工午餐會

您好：
我想參加午餐會，但我的客戶會議要到下午 1 點才結束。我之後可以用視訊加入嗎？從那時起我就有空了，而且我最想聽 Lin 博士的演說。身為其他辦公室的與會者，我也想知道頒獎過程會不會線上播出。

questions.stem: Why did Mr. Reyes write the e-mail?
options: To invite Dr. Lin to give a talk
To ask for a different meal
To ask if he can take part in the event from far away
questions.explain: Reyes 問能否在會議結束後以視訊加入午餐會，故選 (D)。(B) 客戶會議是他無法準時參加的原因，他並未取消。
questions.evidence: Can I join by video after that?

questions.stem: What is the luncheon for?
options: To thank employees and share ideas
questions.explain: 公告提到頒發年度獎項及團隊合作的演說，是對員工表揚與分享，故選 (A)。(C) 公告沒有提到新專案的規劃。
questions.evidence: At 12:45, we will give out the yearly awards.

questions.stem: Which part of the luncheon will Mr. Reyes probably miss?
questions.explain: 需合併兩份文件：公告說 12:45 頒獎、1:15 演說；Reyes 的會議要到 1:00 才結束，所以會錯過 12:45 的頒獎，故選 (C)。(B) 他說之後就有空，且最想聽的就是 Lin 博士的演說，所以不會錯過。
questions.evidence: I would like to join the luncheon, but my client meeting does not end until 1:00 p.m.

questions.stem: What is suggested about the Taipei office?
options: Its staff are allowed to join the luncheon online.
questions.explain: 公告說台北辦公室同仁可用視訊參加，故選 (B)。
questions.evidence: Staff in our Taipei office can join by videoconference.

vocab.stem: The ______ will be held at noon, and lunch will be served for all staff.
vocab.explain: 中午舉行並提供午餐，指的是午餐會，故選 luncheon。blueprint（藍圖）、modem（數據機）、itinerary（行程表）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: We need to ______ the guest list by Monday so that the hotel can prepare the right number of seats.
vocab.explain: 要在週一前把名單定案，好讓飯店準備座位，故選 finalize（定案）。overlook（忽略）、unplug（拔插頭）、misplace（弄丟）都不合句意。

title: Email: Hotel Booking Confirmation
topic: 電子郵件・飯店訂房確認
paragraphs:
To: Ms. Olivia Tan
From: Seaview Hotel Reservations
Subject: Your booking confirmation

Thank you for choosing the Seaview Hotel. We are pleased to confirm your stay from May 14 to May 17 in a [[deluxe|TO-0061]] room with an ocean view. Breakfast is [[complimentary|TO-0050]] for all guests, and our [[spa|TO-0058]] and pool are open every day from 8 a.m. to 9 p.m.

[[Checkout|TO-0055]] time is 11 a.m. If you need to leave your bags after that, our [[doorman|TO-0066]] will keep them safe. Our [[concierge|TO-0056]] can also help with taxis, dinner plans, and a one-day [[excursion|TO-0053]] to the national park. Because of heavy [[congestion|TO-0059]] on the highway from the airport on Fridays, we suggest that you leave the airport early or take the train.

If you must change your plans, you may make a free [[cancellation|TO-0052]] up to 48 hours before your arrival. After that, one night's charge will apply. Guests from other countries may need a power [[adapter|TO-0063]], and we are happy to lend one at the front desk.
zh:
收件者：Olivia Tan 女士
寄件者：Seaview 飯店訂房組
主旨：您的訂房確認
感謝您選擇 Seaview 飯店。我們很高興確認您 5 月 14 日至 5 月 17 日入住一間可看海景的豪華客房。所有房客均可免費享用早餐，水療館和游泳池每天早上 8 點至晚上 9 點開放。
退房時間為上午 11 點。如果您在那之後還需要寄放行李，我們的門僮會妥善保管。禮賓人員也可以協助安排計程車、晚餐，以及前往國家公園的一日遊。由於每逢週五，機場聯外公路都會嚴重壅塞，建議您提早離開機場或搭乘火車。
如果您必須更改計畫，最晚可在抵達前 48 小時免費取消。超過時間，將收取一晚的費用。來自其他國家的旅客可能需要電源轉接頭，我們很樂意在櫃檯借給您一個。

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To confirm a reservation and give useful information
To ask a guest to pay a bill
To advertise a new hotel pool
To explain why a room is not ready
questions.explain: 信件一開頭就確認住房日期與房型，後面提供退房、交通與取消規定，故選 (A)。(B) 信中沒有要求付款。
questions.evidence: We are pleased to confirm your stay from May 14 to May 17 in a deluxe room with an ocean view.

questions.stem: Who can help guests plan a trip to the national park?
questions.explain: 第二段說禮賓人員可以協助安排一日遊，故選 (B)。(A) 門僮的工作是替客人保管行李，不負責安排行程。
questions.evidence: Our concierge can also help with taxis, dinner plans, and a one-day excursion to the national park.

questions.stem: The word "suggest" in the e-mail is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: suggest that you leave early 是「建議」，與 recommend 意思最接近，故選 (B)。(C) refuse 是「拒絕」，與句意相反。
questions.evidence: Because of heavy congestion on the highway from the airport on Fridays, we suggest that you leave the airport early or take the train.

questions.stem: What will probably happen if Ms. Tan cancels on May 13?
options: She will get all her money back.
She will receive a free breakfast.
She will be asked to stay longer.
She will have to pay for one night.
questions.explain: 免費取消限抵達前 48 小時，5 月 13 日已不足 48 小時，會被收一晚費用，故選 (D)。(A) 只有在 48 小時前取消才能全額退款。
questions.evidence: After that, one night's charge will apply.

vocab.stem: The hotel gives guests a ______ cup of coffee when they arrive.
vocab.explain: 飯店送給客人的咖啡，是免費招待的，故選 complimentary。deluxe（豪華的）、adjacent（鄰近的）、crowded（擁擠的）都不能說明咖啡由飯店贈送。

vocab.stem: Heavy traffic ______ on the main road made us miss our flight.
vocab.explain: 交通壅塞使人錯過班機，故選 congestion。checkout（退房）、excursion（短程旅行）、amenity（便利設施）都無法與 traffic 搭配。

title: Itinerary: Trip to Singapore
paragraphs: Business Trip [[Itinerary|TO-0049]]: Mr. Ken Liu, Singapore, June 9–11

Monday, June 9
8:10 a.m. Flight leaves Taipei. The [[airfare|TO-0054]] was paid by the company.
1:00 p.m. Hotel shuttle to the Harbor Hotel. Shuttle [[riders|TO-0064]] must show a booking number.
7:00 p.m. Welcome dinner in the hotel [[ballroom|TO-0065]]. Please choose one [[entrée|TO-0057]]: fish, chicken, or vegetables.

Tuesday, June 10
9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Sales conference, Room 4
6:00 p.m. Optional [[excursion|TO-0053]]: night boat tour (US$30, pay at the front desk).

Wednesday, June 11
11:00 a.m. [[Checkout|TO-0055]]. Hotel [[amenities|TO-0060]] such as the pool and gym may be used until then.
5:30 p.m. Flight leaves for Taipei.
Mr. Liu may extend the trip as a short weekend [[getaway|TO-0067]] at his own cost. If he wishes to do so, he should tell Ms. Cruz in the travel office by May 30.
zh: 出差行程表：Ken Liu 先生，新加坡，6 月 9 至 11 日

6 月 9 日星期一
上午 8:10 班機從台北起飛。機票費用已由公司支付。
下午 1:00 搭乘飯店接駁車前往 Harbor 飯店。搭乘接駁車的乘客須出示訂房編號。
晚上 7:00 在飯店大宴會廳舉行歡迎晚宴。請選擇一道主菜：魚、雞肉或蔬菜。

6 月 10 日星期二
上午 9:00 至下午 5:00 業務會議，4 號房
晚上 6:00 自由參加的遊覽：夜間遊船（30 美元，請到櫃檯付款）。

6 月 11 日星期三
上午 11:00 退房。在那之前可使用飯店的游泳池與健身房等設施。
下午 5:30 班機飛回台北。
Liu 先生可以自費把行程延長，當成一趟短暫的週末小旅行。如果他想這麼做，應在 5 月 30 日前告訴旅遊部門的 Cruz 女士。

questions.stem: What is the document mainly about?
options: A plan for a business trip
A report on a sales conference
questions.explain: 文件依日期列出班機、住宿、會議與活動，是 Liu 先生出差的行程計畫，故選 (C)。(D) 業務會議只是行程中的一項，並非文件重點。
questions.evidence: Business Trip Itinerary: Mr. Ken Liu, Singapore, June 9–11

questions.stem: Who paid for Mr. Liu's flight to Singapore?
questions.explain: 行程表第一天寫明機票費用已由公司支付，故選 (D)。(A) Liu 先生只需自付額外延長行程的費用。
questions.evidence: The airfare was paid by the company.

questions.stem: What is Mr. Liu asked to do for the dinner on Monday?
questions.explain: 行程表寫明週一的歡迎晚宴要選一道主菜，故選 (A)。(B) 出示訂房編號是搭乘接駁車的規定。
questions.evidence: Please choose one entrée: fish, chicken, or vegetables.

questions.stem: The word "extend" in the last paragraph is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: extend the trip 是把行程延長，與 make longer 意思最接近，故選 (A)。(B) 文中說延長的費用由本人負擔，並不是變便宜。
questions.evidence: Mr. Liu may extend the trip as a short weekend getaway at his own cost.

vocab.stem: The hotel has several ______, including a pool, a gym, and a free parking lot.
vocab.explain: 泳池、健身房與停車場都是飯店提供的便利設施，故選 amenities。riders（乘客）、entrées（主菜）、cancellations（取消）都不能指這些設施。

vocab.stem: Please keep your ______ with you so that you know the time and place of each event.
vocab.explain: 要知道每場活動的時間地點，要帶著行程表，故選 itinerary。spa（水療館）、doorman（門衛）、airfare（機票費用）都不是用來查時間地點的東西。

title: Ad and Email: Lakeside Weekend
topic: 廣告與電子郵件・度假套裝行程（雙篇）
paragraphs:
--- Advertisement ---
Lakeside Resort Weekend [[Getaway|TO-0067]]
Only $240 per person for two nights (Friday to Sunday). Offer valid from September 1 to October 31.

Your package includes a [[deluxe|TO-0061]] room, a three-course dinner on Saturday with your choice of [[entrée|TO-0057]], and one 60-minute massage at our [[spa|TO-0058]]. A [[complimentary|TO-0050]] shuttle meets every train. Our [[concierge|TO-0056]] can plan a boat or hiking [[excursion|TO-0053]] for you.
Because of high [[occupancy|TO-0051]] on weekends, please book early. A [[cancellation|TO-0052]] made within three days of arrival will not be refunded.

--- E-mail ---
To: Lakeside Resort Reservations
From: Marcus Grant
Date: September 12
Subject: Weekend package

Dear Sir or Madam,
My wife and I would like to book the weekend package for October 4 to 6. We will arrive by train at 4:00 p.m. on Friday. Could you tell me the total price? Also, can the massage be booked for Sunday morning? We would like to try the hiking trip on Saturday, too.
zh:
--- 廣告 ---
Lakeside 度假村週末小旅行
兩晚（週五至週日）每人僅需 240 美元。優惠期間為 9 月 1 日至 10 月 31 日。
您的套裝行程包含一間豪華客房、週六的三道式晚餐（可自選主菜），以及水療館 60 分鐘按摩一次。免費接駁車會配合每班火車。我們的禮賓人員可以為您安排划船或健行的遊覽。
由於週末住房率很高，請及早訂房。抵達前三天內取消，恕不退費。

--- 電子郵件 ---
收件者：Lakeside 度假村訂房組
寄件者：Marcus Grant
日期：9 月 12 日
主旨：週末套裝行程

敬啟者：
我和太太想預訂 10 月 4 日至 6 日的週末套裝行程。我們週五下午 4:00 搭火車抵達。可以告訴我總價是多少嗎？另外，按摩可以訂在週日早上嗎？我們週六也想體驗健行。

questions.stem: Why did Mr. Grant write to the resort?
options: To thank the resort for its service
To ask about booking a package
questions.explain: Grant 想預訂週末套裝行程，並詢問價格與按摩時間，故選 (D)。(B) 他是要預訂，並未取消。
questions.evidence: My wife and I would like to book the weekend package for October 4 to 6.

questions.stem: What is included in the package?
questions.explain: 廣告說套裝行程包含一次水療館的按摩，故選 (A)。(B) 廣告完全沒有提到機票。
questions.evidence: Your package includes a deluxe room, a three-course dinner on Saturday with your choice of entrée, and one 60-minute massage at our spa.

questions.stem: How much will Mr. Grant and his wife pay for the package?
questions.explain: 需合併兩份文件：廣告說每人 240 美元，Grant 說他和太太兩人要預訂，故 240 × 2 = 480 美元，選 (B)。(A) 240 美元只是一個人的價格。
questions.evidence: Only $240 per person for two nights (Friday to Sunday).

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the resort on weekends?
questions.explain: 廣告因週末住房率高而提醒及早訂房，可推知週末常客滿，故選 (C)。(B) 廣告說免費接駁車會配合每班火車，並沒有說沒有火車。
questions.evidence: Because of high occupancy on weekends, please book early.

vocab.stem: The hotel was at full ______ during the holiday, so we could not find a room.
vocab.explain: 假期期間沒有空房，表示住房率已滿，故選 occupancy。itinerary（行程表）、airfare（機票費用）、getaway（短期休閒旅行）都不能與 full 搭配。

vocab.stem: Dinner comes with a choice of fish or chicken as the ______.
vocab.explain: 晚餐可選魚或雞肉，指的是主菜，故選 entrée。checkout（退房）、adapter（轉接頭）、concierge（禮賓人員）都不是菜色。

title: Email: A Faulty Vacuum Cleaner
topic: 電子郵件・商品瑕疵客訴
paragraphs:
To: Customer Service, Bright Home Store
From: Helen Park
Subject: Problem with order 5521
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing about the [[cordless|TO-0089]] vacuum cleaner I bought from your online shop on March 3. It worked well for the first week, but now it stops after two minutes. The unit is clearly [[faulty|TO-0076]]. I called your [[hotline|TO-0079]] twice, but no one answered. This has been a real [[inconvenience|TO-0068]] because my family is visiting on Saturday.
I also believe I was [[overcharged|TO-0086]]. The product page said $89, but my card was charged $98. As a regular [[purchaser|TO-0075]] of your products, I hope you can correct this.

Please send me a new vacuum cleaner and [[expedite|TO-0091]] the delivery if possible. I would also like the $9 shipping fee to be [[waived|TO-0088]], since the error was not mine. The receipt is attached.

Sincerely,
Helen Park
zh:
收件人：明亮居家商店客服部
寄件人：海倫・帕克
主旨：訂單 5521 的問題
敬啟者：
我寫信是想談談 3 月 3 日我在貴店網路商店購買的無線吸塵器。它第一個星期運作良好，但現在開機兩分鐘就停了。這台機器顯然有瑕疵。我打了兩次貴公司的服務專線，卻沒有人接聽。這造成了很大的不便，因為我的家人星期六要來拜訪。
我也認為我被多收了錢。商品頁面標示 89 美元，但我的卡被扣了 98 美元。身為貴公司產品的常客，我希望你們能更正這件事。
請寄給我一台新的吸塵器，並且盡可能加快出貨。由於錯誤不在我，我也希望貴公司能免除這 9 美元的運費。收據已附上。

敬上
海倫・帕克

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To ask for the store's opening hours
To report a problem and ask for a replacement
To order a second vacuum cleaner
questions.explain: 信中說吸塵器有瑕疵、被多收錢，並請對方寄新的一台，所以目的是回報問題並要求更換，故選 (B)。(C) 她要的是換新，不是再買第二台。
questions.evidence: Please send me a new vacuum cleaner and expedite the delivery if possible.

questions.stem: How much was Ms. Park charged on her card?
questions.explain: 信中寫商品頁面是 89 美元，但她的卡被扣了 98 美元，故選 (C)。(A) 89 美元是標示的價格；(B) 9 美元是運費。
questions.evidence: The product page said $89, but my card was charged $98.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about Ms. Park?
options: She has bought from the store before.
She wants a full refund instead of a new product.
She bought the cleaner in a physical shop.
questions.explain: 她自稱 regular purchaser（常客），可推知以前買過該店商品，故選 (A)。(C) 她要求寄一台新的吸塵器，並沒有要求全額退款；(D) 她說是 online shop 購買，不是實體店。
questions.evidence: As a regular purchaser of your products, I hope you can correct this.

questions.stem: The word "waived" in the e-mail is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: 運費被 waived 即「免除」，與 removed 最接近，故選 (D)。(B) increased 剛好相反。
questions.evidence: I would also like the $9 shipping fee to be waived, since the error was not mine.

vocab.stem: We are sorry for any ______ this delay has caused you.
vocab.explain: 向顧客為延誤道歉，應說造成的「不便」，故選 inconvenience。invitation（邀請）、inspection（檢查）、instruction（指示）都不通。

vocab.stem: If you need help with your order, please call our ______ at any time.
vocab.explain: 需要協助時打的是「服務專線」，故選 hotline。deadline（截止期限）、headline（標題）、guideline（準則）都不是可以撥打的電話。

title: Ad: Spring Sale Weekend
topic: 廣告・汽車展示間促銷
paragraphs:
Harbor Motors
Spring Sale Weekend, April 12-13

Visit our [[showroom|TO-0073]] at 45 Lake Road this weekend for the biggest [[promotional|TO-0074]] event of the year. Harbor Motors has been a trusted [[dealership|TO-0084]] in the [[automotive|TO-0093]] business for thirty years.

The Lark [[sedan|TO-0095]] is now $17,900, down from $19,500. A friendly [[salesperson|TO-0071]] will help you [[customize|TO-0080]] your car with the seat color and wheel style you like. Every buyer also gets a free name [[sticker|TO-0083]] for the door.

Please note that the older Pine model will be [[discontinued|TO-0081]] after June, so this is your last chance to buy one. New customers can book an [[introductory|TO-0082]] service visit for only $20.
Bring this [[flyer|TO-0072]] to the front desk for a free cup of coffee. Open daily from 9 A.M. to 7 P.M.
zh:
港灣汽車
春季特賣週末，4 月 12 至 13 日
本週末歡迎蒞臨位於湖濱路 45 號的展示間，參加今年最盛大的促銷活動。港灣汽車在汽車業中是值得信賴的經銷商，已有三十年歷史。
雲雀轎車現在售價 17,900 美元，原價為 19,500 美元。親切的銷售人員會協助您依喜好選擇座椅顏色與輪圈款式，量身打造您的愛車。每位購車者還可獲贈一張車門用的姓名貼紙。
請注意，較舊的松木款將於 6 月之後停產，所以這是購買它的最後機會。新客戶只需 20 美元，就能預約新客優惠保養。
帶著這張傳單到櫃檯，可免費領一杯咖啡。每天上午 9 點至晚上 7 點營業。

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
options: To promote a sale at a car dealer
To announce a new store location
To explain how to repair a car

title: Newsletter and E-mail: A Boot Rebate
topic: 電子報＋郵件・鞋店回饋金
paragraphs:
--- Newsletter ---
Stride Shoes Monthly Newsletter, May Edition

This month, our [[footwear|TO-0094]] line has a new hiking boot, the Ridge Walker. Buy a pair by May 31 and mail in the form to receive a $15 [[rebate|TO-0085]]. Unlike [[generic|TO-0078]] boots sold in discount stores, the Ridge Walker comes with a two-year warranty. All orders are [[refundable|TO-0087]] within 30 days if the boots are unworn. For $5 more, you can [[personalize|TO-0090]] your pair with your initials. Orders are delivered by our delivery [[provider|TO-0069]], Swift Post, within three days. Thank you for reading this month's [[newsletter|TO-0070]].

--- E-mail ---
To: Stride Shoes
From: Tom Alvarez
Subject: My Ridge Walker order

Dear Stride Shoes,
I ordered a pair of Ridge Walkers on May 10, with my initials added. The boots are very comfortable. However, I found Swift Post [[unreliable|TO-0096]]: the package arrived on May 19, not within three days. Also, I mailed my rebate form on May 20, but I have not heard anything yet. Could you please confirm that I will still receive the $15? Thank you.
Tom Alvarez
zh:
--- 電子報 ---
跨步鞋業每月電子報，5 月號
本月，我們的鞋類產品系列推出了一款新登山靴「山脊行者」。5 月 31 日前購買一雙並寄回表格，即可獲得 15 美元的退款回饋。不同於折扣商店販售的無品牌靴子，「山脊行者」附有兩年保固。所有訂單只要靴子未穿過，30 天內都可退款。只需多付 5 美元，您就能在靴子上刻印您的姓名縮寫。訂單由我們的配送業者迅郵於三天內送達。感謝您閱讀本月電子報。

--- 電子郵件 ---
收件人：跨步鞋業
寄件人：湯姆・阿爾瓦雷斯
主旨：我的山脊行者訂單

跨步鞋業您好：
我在 5 月 10 日訂了一雙山脊行者，並加上了我的姓名縮寫。靴子非常舒適。不過，我覺得迅郵不可靠：包裹 5 月 19 日才到，而不是三天內。另外，我 5 月 20 日寄出了回饋表格，但至今沒有收到任何回覆。能否請您確認我仍會收到那 15 美元？謝謝。
湯姆・阿爾瓦雷斯

title: Email: A Payroll Mistake
topic: 電子郵件・薪資多付更正
paragraphs:
To: Ben Cruz
From: Rita Gomez, Payroll Office
Subject: Error in your February paycheck
Dear Mr. Cruz,

During a review of the February [[payroll|TO-0109]], we found that we [[overpaid|TO-0123]] you by $240. The mistake came from your [[overtime|TO-0098]] hours. Your six extra hours on February 8 were counted twice, so your [[paycheck|TO-0101]] was too high.

We know you may feel [[apprehensive|TO-0129]] about this message, so please be assured that you will not be [[penalized|TO-0124]] in any way. With your agreement, we will make a small [[debit|TO-0117]] of $80 from each of your next three paychecks. If you prefer to repay everything at once, the full amount is [[payable|TO-0111]] to the Finance Office by March 20.
In the same payment, we will [[reimburse|TO-0104]] you for the $35 train ticket you submitted last month. This [[reimbursement|TO-0120]] will appear on your pay stub as a separate line.

Please reply by Friday to tell us which option you choose.

Best regards,
Rita Gomez
zh:
收件人：班・克魯茲
寄件人：麗塔・戈麥斯，薪資組
主旨：您二月薪資的錯誤
克魯茲先生您好：
在檢查二月薪資名冊時，我們發現多付了您 240 美元。錯誤來自您的加班時數。您 2 月 8 日的六小時加班被重複計算，所以您的薪水金額過高。
我們知道您可能會對這封信感到不安，請放心，您不會受到任何處罰。經您同意後，我們會從您接下來的三次薪水中，各扣除 80 美元的小額款項。如果您希望一次還清，全額可在 3 月 20 日前付給財務處。
在同一筆款項中，我們也會補償您上個月申報的 35 美元火車票費用。這筆報銷款會在您的薪資明細上獨立列為一行。

請在週五前回覆，告訴我們您選擇哪一種方式。

敬上
麗塔・戈麥斯

title: Memo: Summer Internship Program
topic: 備忘錄・暑期實習計畫
paragraphs:
MEMO
To: All staff
From: Priya Nair, Human Resources
Date: May 6
Subject: Summer internship program
This summer, our company will welcome six [[intern|TO-0100]]s from local universities. The [[internship|TO-0102]] runs from June 17 to August 23, and each student will work in a different department.

On the first day, all interns will attend an [[induction|TO-0130]] session in Room 301 at 9 A.M. Staff members who will supervise an intern are asked to join the session. Please also review the dress code. Business [[attire|TO-0121]] is not required for interns, but clothing should be neat.

To make the program a success, each department should choose one mentor. A mentor does not need [[managerial|TO-0106]] experience, only patience and a willingness to share knowledge. Interested staff should contact the [[recruiter|TO-0107]] for this program, Mr. Oh, by May 20.

After their first month, interns can use our [[flextime|TO-0119]] schedule. They are also welcome to join the monthly [[wellness|TO-0131]] workshops on stress and exercise. Some outstanding interns may later be offered full-time jobs, even at our Tainan branch, which would require them to [[relocate|TO-0099]].
zh:
備忘錄
收件人：全體員工
寄件人：普莉雅・奈爾，人力資源部
日期：5 月 6 日
主旨：暑期實習計畫
今年夏天，我們公司將迎接六名來自本地大學的實習生。實習期間為 6 月 17 日至 8 月 23 日，每位學生將在不同部門工作。
第一天，所有實習生將於上午 9 點在 301 室參加新進人員訓練。要負責帶領實習生的員工，也請一同參加。另請留意服裝規定。實習生不需要穿正式的商務服裝，但衣著應整潔。
為了讓這項計畫成功，每個部門應選出一位導師。導師不需要有管理經驗，只需要有耐心，並樂於分享知識。有興趣的員工請在 5 月 20 日前，聯絡負責這項計畫的招募人員吳先生。
滿一個月後，實習生可以採用我們的彈性工時。也歡迎他們參加每月舉辦、主題為壓力與運動的身心保健工作坊。部分表現傑出的實習生日後可能獲得全職工作機會，甚至是在我們台南分公司，那就需要他們搬遷過去。

title: Job Ad and E-mail: Event Coordinator

paragraphs:
--- Job Advertisement ---
Greenway Foundation: Event Coordinator

Greenway Foundation, a nonprofit group that protects local rivers, is looking for an Event Coordinator for our main office in Dayton. The ideal person has strong [[organizational|TO-0115]] skills and at least two years of [[managerial|TO-0106]] experience. The coordinator will plan community events and help us [[fundraise|TO-0114]] from local businesses.
Applicants must be willing to [[relocate|TO-0099]]. The foundation offers up to $3,000 for [[relocation|TO-0125]] costs. Send your application to Ms. Ito, our [[recruiter|TO-0107]], by June 30.

--- E-mail ---
To: Ms. Ito
From: Marcus Lee
Subject: Event Coordinator position

Dear Ms. Ito,
I am writing to apply for the Event Coordinator position. For five years, I have worked as a [[freelance|TO-0116]] event planner. During the economic [[downturn|TO-0110]] of 2023, I helped a hospital raise $40,000 while spending less than planned, because I knew how to [[economize|TO-0112]] on food and decorations.
I currently live in Tainan, but I can move to Dayton by August 1. I do not own much furniture, so I may not need the full relocation payment. I hope we can arrange an interview next week.
Sincerely,
Marcus Lee

paragraphs:
To: All renters, Maple Court
From: Dan Wilson, Property Manager
Subject: Hallway renovation
Dear residents,

Maple Court will begin a [[renovation|TO-0132]] of the first-floor hallway and lobby on June 3. We plan to [[renovate|TO-0133]] the floors, lights, and mailboxes. The work should take about four weeks. During this time, workers will [[demolish|TO-0148]] the old wall near the elevator, so you may hear loud noise between 9 A.M. and 5 P.M.

The building owner has also decided to [[remodel|TO-0137]] the laundry room and [[redecorate|TO-0145]] the lobby with new paint and plants. We will keep the front door open, but please keep the walkways clear.

A few first-floor apartments will be affected. Each [[renter|TO-0141]] living there must [[vacate|TO-0142]] the apartment for two nights, June 10 and 11, while the pipes are replaced. We will pay for a hotel room, and workers will leave the hallway in a state of [[cleanliness|TO-0151]] after each day's work.

If you have questions, please call my office.

Dan Wilson
zh:

questions.evidence: Maple Court will begin a renovation of the first-floor hallway and lobby on June 3.

questions.stem: How long will the work take?
questions.explain: 信中說工程約需四週，故選 (D)。(B) 兩晚是部分一樓住戶要搬離的時間，不是整個工程。
questions.evidence: The work should take about four weeks.

questions.stem: Who will have to leave their apartments for two nights?
questions.explain: 信中說只有部分一樓住戶要在 6 月 10、11 日兩晚搬離，故選 (C)。(A) 信中說只有 a few first-floor apartments 受影響。
questions.evidence: A few first-floor apartments will be affected.

questions.stem: The word "vacate" in the e-mail is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: vacate the apartment 是「搬離」，與 leave 最接近，故選 (B)。(D) rent 是租用，方向相反。
questions.evidence: Each renter living there must vacate the apartment for two nights, June 10 and 11, while the pipes are replaced.

vocab.stem: The restaurant will close for a month for a complete ______ of its kitchen.
vocab.explain: 餐廳關門一個月是為了廚房的「整修」，故選 renovation。invitation（邀請）、reputation（名聲）、registration（登記）都不符。

vocab.stem: The city plans to ______ the old bridge next year and build a new one.
vocab.explain: 蓋新橋之前要「拆除」舊橋，故選 demolish。decorate（裝飾）、borrow（借）、vacate（搬離）都與後面「蓋一座新橋」接不起來。

title: Notice: Building Safety Rules
paragraphs:
NOTICE
Sunset Tower Management Office
Posted: September 1
Following the fire drill last week, the management office would like to remind every [[occupant|TO-0144]] of our [[condominium|TO-0146]] about several safety rules.

First, a fire [[extinguisher|TO-0147]] is on every floor next to the elevator. Please do not move or borrow it. Second, cooking must never be left [[unattended|TO-0134]]. Last month, a pot left on a stove caused smoke in Unit 12B.

Third, the elevator has had a [[malfunction|TO-0135]] twice this summer. If it stops, press the alarm button and do not try to open the door. During a power [[outage|TO-0149]], the emergency lights will turn on automatically. In a drill, please walk in a single line so that the stairway does not become [[overcrowded|TO-0150]].
Each [[homeowner|TO-0143]] is asked to read this notice and sign the form at the front desk by September 15. Thank you for helping us keep Sunset Tower safe.
zh:
公告
日落大樓管理室
張貼日期：9 月 1 日
上週的消防演習之後，管理室想提醒本大廈的每位住戶幾項安全規定。
首先，每層樓電梯旁都設有滅火器。請勿移動或借用。第二，烹煮食物時絕不可無人看管。上個月，12B 室就有一只鍋子留在爐上沒人看顧，結果冒出煙來。
第三，電梯今年夏天已經故障兩次。如果電梯停住，請按警鈴，不要試圖打開門。停電期間，緊急照明會自動亮起。演習時，請排成單列步行，以免樓梯間過於擁擠。
請每位屋主閱讀本公告，並於 9 月 15 日前到櫃檯在表格上簽名。感謝您協助我們維護日落大樓的安全。

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To announce the date of a fire drill
To explain how to rent a unit
To remind residents of safety rules
To report that an elevator has been repaired
questions.explain: 公告整理了滅火器、烹飪、電梯與停電等安全規則，目的是提醒住戶，故選 (C)。(A) 演習已經在上週舉行過。
questions.evidence: Following the fire drill last week, the management office would like to remind every occupant of our condominium about several safety rules.

questions.stem: Where can residents find a fire extinguisher?
options: Next to the elevator on each floor
questions.explain: 公告說每層樓電梯旁都有滅火器，故選 (B)。
questions.evidence: First, a fire extinguisher is on every floor next to the elevator.

questions.stem: What most likely happened in Unit 12B last month?
options: A pot on a stove was left alone and made smoke.
questions.explain: 公告以 12B 室為例說明烹煮不可無人看管，所以是爐上的鍋子造成冒煙，故選 (A)。(B) 電梯故障是另一件事。
questions.evidence: Last month, a pot left on a stove caused smoke in Unit 12B.

questions.stem: The word "unattended" in the notice is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: cooking must never be left unattended 指烹煮時不可「無人看管」，與 left alone 相近，故選 (B)。
questions.evidence: Second, cooking must never be left unattended.

vocab.stem: The ______ of the building must pay a monthly fee for the shared garden.
vocab.explain: 按月付費的是大樓裡的「住戶」，故選 occupants。outages（停電）、extinguishers（滅火器）、dealerships（經銷商）都不是會付費的對象。

vocab.stem: A power ______ left the whole neighborhood in the dark for two hours.
vocab.explain: 整個社區陷入黑暗兩小時是因為「停電」，故選 outage。renovation（整修）、induction（新人訓練）、rebate（退款）都不會讓社區變暗。

title: Ad and E-mail: A House for Sale
paragraphs:
--- Advertisement ---
Bright Key Realty: House for Sale

A three-bedroom house at 28 Elm Street, only ten minutes on foot from Eastside Medical Center. The [[homeowner|TO-0143]] has just finished a full [[remodel|TO-0137]] of the kitchen, which now has a large island, perfect for lovers of [[culinary|TO-0139]] arts. A popular [[diner|TO-0138]] is across the street, and the [[healthcare|TO-0140]] center is a short walk away. Price: $285,000. Contact Amy Chen, our [[realtor|TO-0136]], at 555-0148.

--- E-mail ---
To: Amy Chen
From: Jenna Park
Subject: House on Elm Street

Dear Ms. Chen,
I am a [[renter|TO-0141]] who has lived in a small apartment for six years, and I am now looking for a home to buy. The house looks perfect. May I visit it on Saturday at 10 A.M.? I would like to [[redecorate|TO-0145]] the bedrooms and perhaps [[demolish|TO-0148]] the wall between two small rooms. My budget is $270,000. Do you think the owner may be flexible?
Best wishes,
Jenna Park
zh:
--- 廣告 ---
明鑰不動產：房屋出售
位於榆樹街 28 號的三房住宅，步行到東區醫療中心只要十分鐘。屋主剛完成廚房的全面改建，現在有一座大型中島，非常適合喜愛廚藝的人。對面就有一家人氣簡餐店，醫療保健中心也只要走一小段路。售價：285,000 美元。請聯絡我們的不動產經紀人陳艾咪，電話 555-0148。

--- 電子郵件 ---
收件人：陳艾咪
寄件人：珍娜・帕克
主旨：榆樹街的房子

陳小姐您好：
我是個租屋者，在一間小公寓住了六年，現在想買房子。這棟房子看起來很理想。我可以在星期六上午 10 點去看屋嗎？我想重新裝潢臥室，也許還要拆掉兩間小房間之間的牆。我的預算是 270,000 美元。您覺得屋主有可能彈性處理嗎？
祝好
珍娜・帕克

questions.stem: Why did Ms. Park write to Ms. Chen?
options: To ask about visiting the house and the price
questions.explain: 她想週六看屋，並詢問屋主是否能在價格上讓步，故選 (B)。(A) 她是租屋者，沒有房子可賣。
questions.evidence: May I visit it on Saturday at 10 A.M.?

questions.stem: What has the homeowner recently done?
questions.explain: 廣告說屋主剛完成廚房的全面改建，故選 (C)。(B) 重新布置臥室是帕克小姐的打算。
questions.evidence: The homeowner has just finished a full remodel of the kitchen, which now has a large island, perfect for lovers of culinary arts.

questions.stem: How much lower is Ms. Park's budget than the asking price?
questions.explain: 廣告售價 285,000 美元，帕克小姐的預算為 270,000 美元，差 15,000 美元，故選 (D)。這題需要兩份文件的資訊。
questions.evidence: My budget is $270,000.

questions.stem: What is suggested about Ms. Park?
options: She does not own a home now.
She works at the medical center.
She is a real estate agent.
She wants to rent the house.
questions.explain: 她說自己是租屋者，現在想買房，可知她目前沒有自己的房子，故選 (A)。(D) 她要買，不是租。
questions.evidence: I am a renter who has lived in a small apartment for six years, and I am now looking for a home to buy.

vocab.stem: Only the ______ can decide whether to sell the house.
vocab.explain: 能決定房子要不要賣的只有「屋主」，故選 homeowner。realtor（經紀人）只負責仲介，不能替屋主做決定；diner（用餐者）、culinary（烹飪的，形容詞）都不符句意。

vocab.stem: We plan to ______ the living room with new curtains and a new carpet.
vocab.explain: 加新窗簾與地毯是在「重新布置」客廳，故選 redecorate。demolish（拆除）、vacate（搬離）、penalize（處罰）都不符。
